text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Penepian Fi kepada Pelatih di Pusat

Bertauliah) 2013.

Penepian fi

2. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperaturan (2), fi yang ditetapkan dalam

butiran 3(a)(i) Jadual kepada Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan Kemahiran

Kebangsaan (Fi dan Caj) 2006 [P.U. (A) 409/2006] diketepikan berkenaan dengan

seseorang pelatih yang memohon Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia melalui pusat bertauliah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual.

(2) Penepian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) terpakai bagi Sijil Kemahiran

Malaysia berhubung dengan latihan kemahiran yang telah bermula atau bermula pada

mana-mana tarikh dalam tempoh tiga tahun sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (2) Jadual.

Pembayaran balik fi

3. (1) Pelatih yang disebut dalam peraturan 2 yang telah membayar fi yang

ditetapkan dalam butiran 3(a)(i) Jadual kepada Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan

Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Fi dan Caj) 2006 boleh memohon kepada Ketua Pengarah bagi

pembayaran balik fi itu.

(2) Apabila permohonan di bawah subperaturan (1) diterima, Ketua

Pengarah hendaklah, selepas ditentusahkan, membayar balik fi yang telah dibayar oleh

pelatih itu.

JADUAL

(1) (2)

Pusat Bertauliah Tempoh

1. Science of Life Studies 24/7,

Segambut

1 Oktober 2011 - 30 September 2014

2. Pusat Latihan Gurney, Kuala Lumpur 1 April 2013 - 31 Mac 2016

3. Montfort Youth Centre, Melaka 1 April 2013 - 31 Mac 2016

Dibuat 25 Julai 2013

[KSM/PUU/T/01/12 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)655/II]

 DATUK RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (WAIVER OF FEE TO TRAINEE AT

ACCREDITED CENTRE) REGULATIONS 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of the National Skills

Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development (Waiver

of Fee to Trainee at Accredited Centre) Regulations 2013.

Waiver of fee

2. (1) Subject to subregulation (2), the fee as prescribed in item 3(a)(i) of the

Schedule to the National Skills Development (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2006

[P.U. (A) 409/2006] is waived in respect of a trainee who applies for the Malaysian Skills

Certificate through the accredited centre as specified in column (1) of the Schedule.

(2) The waiver of fee under subregulation (1) is applicable for the Malaysian

Skills Certificate in relation to skills training which has commenced or commences on any

date within the period of three years as specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

Refund of fee

3. (1) The trainee referred to in regulation 2 who has paid the fee as prescribed

in item 3(a)(i) of the Schedule to the National Skills Development (Fees and Charges)

Regulations 2006 may apply to the Director General for a refund of the fee.

(2) Upon receipt of the application under subregulation (1), the Director

General shall, after verification, refund the fee paid by the trainee.

SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

Accredited Centre Period

1. Science of Life Studies 24/7,

Segambut

1 October 2011 - 30 September 2014

2. Gurney Training Centre, Kuala

Lumpur

1 April 2013 - 31 March 2016

3. Montfort Youth Centre, Melaka 1 April 2013 - 31 March 2016

Made 25 July 2013
